name: onboarding-progress
description: Read and record progress on the principal's onboarding task. status: the open and done topics of each onboarding session (with the playbook text for open ones), whether a mailbox is connected, whether the greeting was sent, and who Setup was for and the operator's name. open_session: create the topics of a later playbook session (review, check-in, ongoing-rhythm) before running it; safe to repeat. topic_done: mark one topic done, or declined, with a note of what was chosen and applied or why it was declined; onboarding completes itself when the last topic is done. greeting_sent: record that the first greeting went out. operator_notice: record and email the operator about a web_search_failed you hit; the other operator notices are raised by Curia itself.

inputs.session_id: string? (open_session: the playbook session id from status, e.g. review. topic_done: only when the same topic id is open in two sessions)
inputs.topic_id: string? (topic_done: the topic id from status, e.g. style)
inputs.note: string? (topic_done, required there: what the principal chose and what you applied, or why they declined)
inputs.event: string? (operator_notice: web_search_failed — the only notice only the model can see)
inputs.details: object? (operator_notice: facts kept on the task record, e.g. { query }; recorded by key name only and never emailed)

outputs.sessions: array? (status: [{ id, title, opened, open: [{ topicId, title, body, needsMailbox }], done: [{ topicId, title }] }])
outputs.setupFor: string? (status: self when the principal set Curia up, other when an operator did; absent operator means self)
outputs.operatorName: string? (status: the operator's name from Setup, or null)
outputs.topics: array? (open_session: the session's topics with their status)
outputs.createdSubtasks: number? (open_session: how many topics were added now)
outputs.onboardingComplete: boolean? (topic_done: true when this completed onboarding; status: true when onboarding is complete)
outputs.completionPending: string? (topic_done: every topic is closed but the onboarding task could not be completed; call op status to retry)
outputs.recorded: boolean? (greeting_sent; operator_notice: true when the notice was recorded)
outputs.alreadyRaised: boolean? (operator_notice: true when this run already raised it; nothing more is sent)
